method: Coordinate descent over the bark rows against the structure score, no model in the loop and no image inspected. A trial renders the species' trunk still headless at the pinned pose and measures it; a trial that improves the score then pays for the guards - the distance, resolution and redraw numbers the shipped tests assert, computed in the same process at the same poses against the same masks and bounds - and is kept only if they all hold. A row that stops paying has its step halved; the climb stops when nothing moves at the finest step, or when five accepted steps at the finest step together buy under one per cent, or at sixty sweeps.
score: The normalised weighted distance from the still's structure vector to the centroid of its catalogued references' vectors. Weights and scales are stated in crates/telperion-render/src/structure.rs.

rounds.note: The shipped round. An isotropic partition puts the crest that shades a floor anywhere within a wall, so two steps over the ridge's shoulder stepped across it: the term measured 0.0371 of a criterion of 0.05 until the walk and the row were corrected.

rounds.primitive: the cellular partition with a furrow-width row, and the plate means re-measured
rounds.note: Two things changed under the climb before it ran. The three pinned plate means were re-measured over sixteen slices of the network instead of one - a single slice estimates the mean to three hundredths, more than the tolerance it is asserted against - and the test now reads the shipped rows from the presets instead of keeping a copy that had drifted a round behind. The corrected means move where the 45% threshold lands on the crop, which cost the oak 0.295 of score before a single row moved: its start is 1.5231 against the 1.2284 round two ended at. The descent and the level pass bought 0.194 of that back.
rounds.level_pass: The score is taken on the grey of a crop after an auto-level, so it cannot see how light the trunk stands, and the owner's eye can. With the descent at its plateau every row is walked in whichever direction carries the crop's mean towards the reference, for as long as the score stays within two per cent of the plateau and every guard holds.

level.rule: every channel of the crop mean inside the band around the reference, never further from it than the round started, and the channel order unchanged
every channel of the crop mean inside the band around the reference, never further from it than the round started, and the channel order unchanged

guards: Every accepted step holds the distance, resolution and redraw numbers the shipped tests assert, at the same poses and the same bounds, and may not move any channel of the crop's mean colour by more than six code values or reorder the channels - fn-29's colour is not this spec's to redo, and a score taken on the grey of a crop would otherwise buy a darker furrow with a bluer trunk. The in-process replica was checked against the shipped binaries at the end: it reports 2.3441 / 2.8257 / 1.8028 / 2.9677 / 2.7908 and the test binaries report the same. Round three replaces the drift guard with a level guard: every channel of the crop's mean must stay inside a stated band around the reference photograph's own crop mean and may never move further from it than the round started, the channel order may not change, and the dark fraction may not fall. The oak's band is thirty code values of the owner's white oak (118,119,114), which its crop already sits at the edge of; the spruce's is eighty of the owner's spruce (154,144,140), wide enough to contain the colour fn-29 was accepted at, because which of those two is right is a question the owner has not answered.
